## Video-Catcher 0.2.1

- **Fixed:** a stream sent by the browser extension showed the name of the stream file in the list ("index-f3-v1-a1") instead of the page title. The file itself already had the page title as its name.

Files: `VideoCatcher.exe` (or `VideoCatcher-arm64.exe`) and the extension (`VideoCatcher-extension-chromium.zip`, `VideoCatcher-extension-firefox.zip` or `.xpi`). The extension itself did not change.

The files are not digitally signed yet; Windows SmartScreen may warn. Every file is built by GitHub Actions from this repository, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists their checksums.
